title: cybianthus brasiliensis
intro: Cybianthus brasiliensis, commonly known as the Brazilian cybianthus, is a plant species in the family Primulaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine in Brazil due to its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cybianthus brasiliensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
